_doc: Guided 'what do you want to communicate' flow for people who do not write code. Every question is a choice or a short phrase; nothing needs a technical term. Answers become comms/brief.json, which the marketing, outreach, branding and communications loops read.

questions.ask: What do you want people to do after they hear from you?

choices: people who build things like this
email to people who said yes

questions.ask: Anything that must never be said or done? (a phrase, or press enter for the defaults)
In your own words, one sentence you want said exactly as written (optional)
